thread:
lina: Heads up — found an orphan SDK snippet on the Optimize Toolkit page that references old quant profile flags. Link 404s. Can someone do a quick PR?
priya: Thanks — which file/path is it?
lina: docs/optimize/toolkit.md around line ~420. The snippet block calls `QuantProfile` and links to /docs/old-qprofs.md (404). Here's the snippet I grabbed: ```python
from redwood import optimize
qp = optimize.QuantProfile(precision='q4', calibration='static')
```
marc: I can take the PR. Do we want to update the snippet to the new API (QuantConfig) and add a short migration note?
josh: We should also add a minimal example showing batching + KV cache along with quant config. Users hit both patterns together.
priya: Agreed. Lina — can you paste a working snippet for the new API so Marc can use it in the PR?
lina: Yup, quick draft below — switching to QuantConfig and removing the old flags: ```python
from redwood.optimize import QuantConfig
qc = QuantConfig(precision='int8', calibration='perchannel')
# attach qc to serve config
serve_cfg = {"model": "gemma-1", "quant": qc}
``` Also plan to point the link at /docs/optimize/quantization-profiles.md instead.
marc: Perfect. I'll open the PR and add a changelog entry. cc @doc-bot for the link/anchor check.
doc-bot: Auto-link-check queued for PR. Note: /docs/optimize/quantization-profiles.md currently lacks an internal anchor `#calibration` — adding that in the PR will fix the redirect.
josh: :thumbsup: Please add an integration example that loads the snippet in the examples/playground build so the CI catches future regressions.
lina: Will add a tiny unit test under examples/ that imports QuantConfig and asserts the repr contains 'int8' so it's quick to run.
priya: If we rename QuantProfile -> QuantConfig we should add a one-liner in the migration guide and a sed snippet for customers who scripted the old name. Example: `git grep -l "QuantProfile" | xargs sed -i 's/QuantProfile/QuantConfig/g'`
marc: Timeline? I can do the PR today if folks are ok with the changes, request reviews tomorrow.
josh: Assign to me for review and I'll check the batching example and KV cache snippet. Also please update the SDK changelog and python package release notes.
lina: :eyes: Branch pushed `lina/docs/opt-snippet-fix` and draft PR created https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422 — PR has both snippet update, link fix, and new test file.
priya: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with migration note and add the sed example once the PR is open.
doc-bot: Link-check: PR referenced, will re-run after CI. CI note: playground build flakes on macOS runners sometimes — will ignore unrelated flakiness.
marc: Thanks all — plan to merge after +2 reviews and green CI. Tagging for release: 2026-04 doc patch. :tada:
